metadata.annotation_unit: one current user request expressed against a short multi-turn dialog context, mapped to a fine-grained intent set

construction.method: Manually curated multi-turn benchmark targeting context resolution: anaphora, ellipsis, topic switch, stale or resolved history, contextual negation, and cross-turn multi-intent assembly.

limitations: The cases are synthetic and are not sampled from production traffic.
The gold labels have not received independent business review.
This fixture must not be edited after its first live run; observed failures belong in regression data.
